notes.title: Windows OS version has been updated to 1.0.2.
notes.content:
Windows OS version has been updated to 1.0.2.
To improve compatibility with Steam Deck, the Windows version is now set to use DirectX 11.

SteamOS runs the Windows version using a technology called Proton.
It is said that DX11 provides more stable performance, so I made this adjustment as preparation.

If you manage to run it on Steam Deck, I would appreciate it if you could report your experience in the community hub threads.
Thank you for your continued support of Sauna of the DEAD!

notes.title: Sauna of the DEAD Full Version is Released!
notes.content:
Sauna of the DEAD has transitioned from Early Access to its full release!
Enjoy a 30% discount during our launch sale and dive into the ultimate experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872245/72fb21fed57df0bda5a1d9b44913b8cd95cbbd36.png[/img]

Become a Heat Wave Master as you manage the demon realm’s saunas.
Wield your heat waves to put order among the zombies and denizens refreshing in the demonic saunas.

Japanese-style Sento Sauna!

Story Sauna – Embark on a journey around the saunas to prepare for the Demon King!
Sauna Endless Summer – In endless mode, keep refreshing the demon realm’s residents until you run out of steam!
Sauna Fairy Tale – Start from nothing, grow stronger, and confront the Dark Heat Wave Master!

Combine leveling up, equipping sauna gear, and buff-granting sauna drinks to unleash unstoppable heat waves across the demon realm!

A heartfelt thank you to everyone who provided feedback during Early Access. Your insights made this full release possible.

Enjoy the world of Sauna of the DEAD!

notes.title: Major Update Released! Conquer the High-Difficulty Sauna Dungeon.
notes.content:
A major update has been released!

Thank you for your patience.
We’ve added the high-difficulty dungeon Sauna Building: Fairytale and two new skills.

[h3]High-Difficulty Dungeon[/h3]

This is an extremely challenging dungeon where you start with no level and no sauna items.
Can you liberate the sauna Fairytale that has been taken over by the Dark Heat Master? Challenge yourself!
Unlocking facilities inside the building will give you an advantage in your quest.

The high-difficulty dungeon Sauna Building: Fairytale unlocks after playing Endless Summer.

[previewyoutube=c0PKgqqAUho;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New Skills[/h3]

[b]Scorching Aufguss[/b]
A skill that delivers a scorching Aufguss across a wide area.
It can be activated by adding firewood to the sauna stove. You can store up to 3 charges and activate them at any time.

[previewyoutube=WkjUz8TmchI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











[b]Wind Ring[/b]
A skill that surrounds your body with wind and targets nearby sauna-goers.
It can be activated through Loyly. You can store up to 3 charges and activate them at any time.

[previewyoutube=wHRwJWk4I0o;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










We’ve also added powerful effects to Loyly and firewood.
Enjoy the special actions that take place in the sauna.
Please give it a try!

We welcome your feedback!
Thank you for your continued support of Sauna of the DEAD.

notes.title: August Development Report
notes.content:
Here’s an update on the development status of Sauna of the DEAD for August.

Thanks to your feedback, we’ve made the following improvements. Thank you for your continued support.

・Fixed an issue where input could become unresponsive after the ending
・Added arrow markers to indicate the attack direction

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872245/503532c8521ddc6e76a6dbcdcb1ce328f41e4f83.png[/img]

In August, we focused on developing a new game mode. The main implementations are as follows:

・Created stages for the new game mode
・Added the Dark Heat Master
・Added new gimmicks
・Dark Heat Master video:

https://youtu.be/r5H1LOsxeL8

Our goal is to make the new game mode playable as soon as possible. We will continue to develop it, exploring the fun elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872245/ba458b2a856a12b6836a296f738e47cbf118d132.png[/img]

Look forward to the new game mode.
This concludes the August activity report.

notes.title: Future Milestones
notes.content:
Are you enjoying Sauna of the DEAD?

I have significantly changed the game balance for Sauna: Endless Summer and transitioned to a new ranking system. Please give it a try.

Now, let me inform you about what I am currently working on. I am developing a new game mode where you will restore a dilapidated sauna that has turned into a dungeon.

Here are the rules I have so far:

・Start at level 1 with no items.
・Collect items needed for sauna restoration and place them in the correct locations.
・The evaluation of the sauna restoration is based on how many necessary items you can place within the limitations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872245/f6697974273e26be3a48dfa523bd54dac6c57c8e.jpg[/img]

Please look forward to the new game mode.
In the meantime, enjoy the newly balanced Endless Summer.

Thank you for your continued support of Sauna of the DEAD.

1. Back up both the correct and incorrect folders finger-tip/SaunaOfTheDEAD and finger-tip/Sauna of the DEAD according to your Win/Mac environment.
2. Copy the 2751820 and 2780140 folders from the finger-tip/SaunaOfTheDEAD folder.
3. Paste them into the finger-tip/Sauna of the DEAD folder.

Save data locations for Windows:
Correct location:
C:/Users/[yourname]/AppData/LocalLow/finger-tip/Sauna of the DEAD
Incorrect location:
C:/Users/[yourname]/AppData/LocalLow/finger-tip/SaunaOfTheDEAD

Save data locations for Mac:
Correct location:
/Users/[yourname]/Library/Application Support/finger-tip/Sauna of the DEAD
Incorrect location:
/Users/[yourname]/Library/Application Support/finger-tip/SaunaOfTheDEAD

I apologize for the inconvenience.
If you have any trouble with the above process, please post on the forum.
I will support you as much as possible.

notes.title: Released demo version 0.2.1.

How are you finding the Sauna of the DEAD demo? We’re on pins and needles without your feedback. Even a single word would suffice, so please let us know what you think!

We’ve released demo version 0.2.1, featuring two major updates:

・Improved visibility during Fever Time
・Detailed explanations of Fever Time effects and activation conditions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872245/c2e261b7839209f18d56f058aa3079e2d7e48840.png[/img]

Fever Time is triggered when the sauna temperature surpasses a specific threshold. For example, in the Zombie Bath, it activates at 100 degrees.
When Fever Time starts, the screen becomes lively with spotlights and other effects. During this period, you can generate massive heat waves by vigorously swinging your towel without consuming stamina.

Both heat wave masters and zombies can enjoy the exhilarating experience of Fever Time. Be sure to give it a try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872245/349e4b9a83eaf24e9ae9bbd33efa2fd46eb5021d.jpg[/img]

Best regards,
The Sauna of the DEAD Development Team, Finger tip

notes.title: The introductory video for the sauna in the underworld.
notes.content:
[h2]Introducing the Sauna of the Underworld[/h2]

[h3]Video[/h3]
Although still in development, we've created a [b]video introducing the Sauna of the Underworld[/b]. Please take a look and write your feedback.

[previewyoutube=Arna5txFrrc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Details[/h3]

[b]Zombie Bath[/b]
A retro-themed bathhouse where zombies gather at night to relax. Be cautious as the zombies' sweat contains toxins!

[b]Spa Love[/b]
A popular spot among bubbly female demons, this location shines at night with its magical pool. Enjoy the magic of these empowered ladies!

[b]Great Sauna Hell[/b]
A comprehensive sauna facility where the underworld's elites gather. This three-story sauna complex is frequented by the Demon King Vihita—a scorching hot hotspot!

notes.title: We have completed the majority of the sauna map implementation.
notes.content:
[h2]Most of Sauna Map Implementation Completed![/h2]

We are excited to update you on the progress of Sauna of the DEAD. The creation of the map is largely complete. We will show you screenshots from around the entrances of three saunas.

[h3]Zombie Bath[/h3]

Zombie Bath is a public bath where zombies gather. In the sauna, zombies approach in groups.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872245/f0a50103cb02b3bdada7e3900aab43f5c115f42f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Spa Love[/h3]

Spa Love is a spa where demon sisters gather night after night. Strategic maneuvering is required to counter magical attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872245/df2c4360b9f5727bd97056a3df897ea0e672ddf5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Sauna Great Hell[/h3]

Sauna Great Hell is a rare three-story public bath facility in the demon world. Demons chase the heat wave masters with varying speeds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872245/696fc4c70f6d790a45e2c279be902f50f7f68ce0.jpg[/img]

[h2]What's Next[/h2]

With the sauna map nearing completion, we plan to make the entire game playable. Stay tuned.
